answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 149998 Country: India Title: I had previously worked in a company that has not paid my dues of some months. Please mention any Quranic dua or wazifah so that I can get back my salary. Question: I had previously worked in a company that has not paid my dues of some months. Please mention any Quranic dua or wazifah so that I can get back my salary. Answer ID: 149998 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 599/480/D=7/1438) Recite the below dua and keep on supplicating Allah, in-shaAllah, the company shall pay your salary. اللهم اكفنى بحلالك عن حرامك واغننى بفضلك عمن سواك . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
